script_text: Stop, Libra—your air-sign scales are trembling under a rare pressure front right now. Venus, your ruling planet, is in Scorpio in your 2nd House and square Pluto in Aquarius in your 5th, forcing you to confront what you truly value. Meanwhile, Jupiter in Leo in your 11th House trines Saturn in Aries in your 7th, turning one serious partnership into a career goldmine. If single, this Venus-Pluto square attracts a magnetic, secretive admirer—don’t mistake intensity for intimacy. If taken, avoid power struggles over money; a calm boundary keeps desire alive. At work, that Jupiter-Saturn trine can bring a promotion offer or contract through a client in your 11th House; negotiate in writing and protect your 2nd House cash flow. Avoid lending money or signing anything during this Venus-Pluto window, and use this window wisely—an unexpected gift is a mentor’s quiet introduction. Follow for tomorrow’s reading, Libra.
